description: Optional Bisociation Engine: use spreading activation and information-gain signals to surface concrete concept pairs that may support an unexpected connection. Supply seed_nodes to spread from the current focus, or omit them for graph-wide mixed sampling. The candidates are provocations for model judgment, not claims that a connection exists.

decay.description: Activation retained per hop for explicit seeds (default: 0.6).

seed_nodes.description: Optional node IDs or titles representing the current focus. Activation spreads through their graph neighborhoods.

steps.description: Maximum spreading-activation hops for explicit seeds (default: 3).

strategy.description: Graph-wide seed strategy when seed_nodes is omitted (default: mixed).

name: graph_bisociate
